endpoints.description: 🎯 Retrieve, search, and download game items - the best API for Steam items.
details: Retrieve all items for a specific game such as CS2, Rust, or Dota2.
Search for specific items using the search parameter.
Apply filters like price_min, price_max, item_group, or wear.
Retrieve detailed item information, including prices, metadata, and market data.
important_notes: This endpoint can return a large amount of data. Use the max parameter to limit results.
For better performance, apply filters like search or price_min to narrow down the results.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Your API key for authentication. Retrieve it from your Dashboard (top-right corner).

parameters.name: game
parameters.description: Short name of the game.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number.

parameters.name: max
parameters.description: Maximum number of items per page.

parameters.name: sort_by
parameters.description: Sorting order: priceAz (Steam price asc, default), priceZa (Steam price desc), priceRealAz (Market price asc), priceRealZa (Market price desc), winLossAz (Win/loss asc), winLossZa (Win/loss desc), soldAz (Sold asc), soldZa (Sold desc), name, pointsAz (Market cap asc), pointsZa (Market cap desc), winner/loser (Real prices vs yesterday).

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search string (minimum 3 characters).

parameters.name: price_min
parameters.description: Minimum Steam price.

parameters.name: price_max
parameters.description: Maximum Steam price.

parameters.name: price_real_min
parameters.description: Minimum real market price.

parameters.name: price_real_max
parameters.description: Maximum real market price.

parameters.name: item_group
parameters.description: Item group name.

parameters.name: item_type
parameters.description: Item type name.

parameters.name: item_name
parameters.description: Item name (e.g., 'Redline' from 'AK-47 | Redline (Minimal Wear)').

parameters.name: wear
parameters.description: Item wear state(s). Examples: 'fn', 'mw', 'ft', 'ww', 'bs'. Multiple allowed, comma-separated string.

parameters.name: select
parameters.description: Select specific fields to return (comma-separated). Reduces response size/time.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Currency code.

parameters.name: production
parameters.description: Set to 1 if running in production. Default is 0. Will be required in the future.

responses.description: Request was successful, and items are returned.

endpoints.description: 📦 Retrieve Item Details with Pricing of all Markets and History
details: Retrieve details of a specific item using its market_hash_name, slug, or hashId.
Provides enriched details like pricing information, tags, metadata, and a brief price history.
endpoints.use_case: Focuses on a single item with detailed data for advanced use cases like market analytics or item tracking.
endpoints.note: Similar to /steam/api/items, but focuses on a single item with enriched details.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Your API key for authentication. Retrieve it from your Dashboard (top-right corner).

parameters.name: market_hash_name
parameters.description: The market_hash_name of the item.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: The desired currency for price conversion (e.g., EUR, TRY, RUB, USD). Default is USD. See the Currency API for available codes.

parameters.name: with_groups
parameters.description: Set to true to retrieve all items within the same group.

parameters.name: production
parameters.description: If you run in production, please set this to 1. Default is 0. This is in future required, and if not set, you will get a warning.

responses.description: Request was successful, and item details are returned.
Item not found. Ensure the market_hash_name is correct.

endpoints.description: 📈 Price History of an Item with Daily Prices from Steam or Real Market Data
details: Retrieves the price history of an item based on specified parameters.
Provides daily prices from Steam or the lowest real market prices if 'markets' is passed as a parameter.
important_notes: Use the interval parameter for optimized data queries.
Specifying 'markets' in origin results in slower responses but provides detailed real market data.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Your API key for authentication. Retrieve it from your Dashboard (top-right corner).

parameters.name: market_hash_name
parameters.description: The market_hash_name of the item.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: Specify the data source. Use 'markets' for real price history (slower and consumes more credits).

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Specify the data type. Options: 'offer', 'median'.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Specify the price source. Use 'skinport' for real prices (works only with type=offer).

parameters.name: interval
parameters.description: Specify the interval for data retrieval.

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: Specify the start date for data retrieval (Format: YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: Specify the end date for data retrieval (Format: YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: production
parameters.description: Set to 1 if running in production. Default is 0. Will be required in the future.

responses.description: Request was successful, and price history is returned.
Invalid start or end date provided.

endpoints.description: 🔍 Retrieve Float Information for an Item
details: Retrieves float information for a specific item in CS:GO or CS2.
Requires the url parameter with a valid inspect link to retrieve the float data.
features: Provides detailed float information for an item.
Supports real-time float retrieval using the item's inspect link.
usage: Use the url parameter to provide the inspect link of the item.
Authenticate with your API key to retrieve the float data.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Your API key for authentication. Retrieve it from your Dashboard (top-right corner).

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The inspect link of the item, e.g., steam://rungame/730/76561202255233023/+csgo_econ_action_preview%20S76561198042843401A35245796926D16321188872112797006. You can retrieve it from our Inventory API for example.

parameters.name: production
parameters.description: Set to 1 if running in production. Default is 0. Will be required in the future.

responses.description: Request was successful, and the float data for the item is returned.
Invalid parameters or inspect link provided.
Service overloaded or not unable to retrive float information. Please try again later.
Unable to retrieve float information for the item.

endpoints.description: 📦 Retrieve Realtime Order Activity for a Steam Item
details: Retrieves order activity details for a specified Steam item.
Includes information such as regional data (country), language-specific details, and price information (currency).
usage: Provide the market_hash_name parameter to specify the item.
Optionally, customize the country, language, and currency parameters for tailored results.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Your API key for authentication. Retrieve it from your Dashboard (top-right corner).

parameters.name: market_hash_name
parameters.description: The market_hash_name of the item.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Country code for regional data.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Language code for localization.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Currency code for prices.

parameters.name: production
parameters.description: Set to 1 if running in production. Default is 0. Will be required in the future.

responses.description: Failed to fetch data from Steam API.
